corrections.reason: The verse numeral following ማር ፲፮ (Mark 16) is clearly printed as ፱ (9, citing Mark 16:9), which was misread as ፩.
The split word across lines 28–29 is the canonical Ge'ez plural noun እደዊሁ ('his hands', John 20:20), and the glyph at the end of line 28 is 6th-order እ.
